notes.title: As Dusk Falls 1.2 Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Our 1.2 Update is now LIVE!

This update provides a fix for multiplayer, resolution settings and High-res texture download.

Fixes:

 Fixed multiplayer issue where players were unable to “Go Online” and join online multiplayer lobbies.
 Fixed issue where players were unable to change resolution settings.
 Fixed High-Resolution Texture Pack not downloading on Steam.


Thank you all for being patient with us whilst we worked through this and for your continued support & feedback!

We are excited for you all to experience As Dusk Falls and have fun with your long-distance friends!

notes.title: One Week Until As Dusk Falls Release: Tribeca, News Round Up and Launch Event
notes.notes:
It’s been a whirlwind month! From Tribeca Festival to seeing As Dusk Falls feature in NME & Famitsu - here’s all the awesome things we got up to since we announced the release date of As Dusk Falls + some exciting launch day news!

Tribeca Festival

As Dusk Falls featured at Tribeca Festival 2022 as part of the official selection of games!

Tribeca is a celebration of storytelling in all its forms - film, TV, audio, and games, held in New York City. We are honoured to have been part of this year’s games program and showcase As Dusk Falls’ demo to festival attendees.

Release Day Announcement & Media Event in New York City

In June, we also announced the release date of As Dusk Falls (did we mention it’s coming on July 19th?!) at the Xbox and Bethesda Showcase!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315155/af37207add314e6e1cf2a9ab3835add1858054d9.jpg

To celebrate, we welcomed press and creators to the Microsoft Experience Centre for a first look of As Dusk Falls and a multiplayer playthrough with INTERIOR/NIGHT’s CEO & Creative Director Caroline Marchal and Production Director Charu Desodt.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315155/e37343cb526ba1966d06baf2b317602677088fe3.jpg

Launch Event

Last but not least - the culmination of years of hard work - As Dusk Falls comes out in just a week! And we have something very special planned…

In Person - July 15th

Xbox and Kinda Funny will be taking over the Fonda Theatre in Los Angeles and turning it into the perfect venue to experience As Dusk Falls. Greg Miller, along with co-hosts SnowBikeMike and Joey Noelle, will bring the Kinda Funny flair to the show with a live We Have Cool Friends, a Kinda Funny Gamescast, and of course, gameplay. 

RSVP here: kindafunny.com/xbox

Online – July 19th

We know not everyone will be able to make it to our LA event, but we still want to celebrate with you! Greg and Kinda Funny Games will be hosting our launch day stream, allowing chat to vote for decisions that happen in-game. Tune in to be a part of the drama that unfolds as you explore the various directions the story can take. Make sure you’re following KindaFunnyGames on Twitch so when the stream goes live on July 19th you don’t miss out. Stream starts at 11 am PT / 7pm BST / 8pm CEST.
